description: An onboarding flow spec is valid when steps are typed correctly, the flow terminates to a non-circular main app target, optional steps declare skip options, returning user and abandonment behaviors are explicit, and all step ids are unique.

rules.description: onboarding-spec.json must exist with flow_id (string), steps (array), and terminationTarget (string). Flows without a spec cannot be validated.
Every step must declare id, title, and type. Steps without these fields cannot be rendered or navigated to.
Every step.type must be one of: info, setup, permission-prompt, tutorial, verification, celebration. Unknown step types produce undefined rendering behavior.
terminationTarget must be a non-empty string. An onboarding flow with no exit target traps users inside the flow.
terminationTarget must not point to a step id within the flow. Circular termination creates an infinite onboarding loop.
Every step with required:false must declare skipLabel and skipTarget. Optional steps without skip controls force users through content they chose not to engage with.

Spec must declare returningUserBehavior as one of: skip-entirely, show-summary, start-from-incomplete, always-show. Returning users without a declared policy get the same new-user experience every login.
Spec must declare abandonedBehavior as save-progress, restart, or ask-user unless singleSession:true. Flows without an abandonment policy lose user progress without warning.
All step ids must be unique within the flow. Duplicate step ids cause broken navigation, progress tracking, and skip targets.
